extraction.project_name: Development of Portal for Management of Waste Tyre through the Extended Producers Responsibility (EPR) Regime
extraction.summary: The requirement document asks for a portal where tyre producers, recyclers and retreaders register, report their data, and generate and trade EPR certificates, with regulators monitoring compliance. It also asks for reports, environmental compensation, audits, a mobile app, a chatbot and training, followed by six years of warranty and maintenance on a government server.

unclear_points.why: One clause says 5000 and above concurrent users, another says 100 to 150.
unclear_points.quote: EPR Portal for waste tyre should able to handle 5000 and above concurrent users.
unclear_points.prebid_query: Module-1 asks for 5000 and above concurrent users while clause 6.1 says 100 to 150 concurrent users. Please confirm the peak concurrent users the portal must support.

unclear_points.why: User numbers are given as wide ranges and elsewhere as about 2000.
unclear_points.quote: 1500 producer, 1500 to 2000 recyclers, 1500 to 2000 Retreader and by users from authorities. The
unclear_points.prebid_query: Module-1 gives ranges for producers, recyclers and retreaders while clause 6.1 says users will be around 2000. Please state the expected number of registered users.

unclear_points.why: The penalty table gives 24 weeks and 4 months from SRS sign-off, while the project duration gives 3 months.
unclear_points.prebid_query: Clause 12.0 gives 24 weeks and 4 months from SRS sign-off for the full portal, while clause 16.0 gives 3 months to go-live. Please confirm the delivery timeline and the date from which it is counted.

unclear_points.why: Round-the-clock operation is stated, but staff are deployed on five days a week in office hours.
unclear_points.prebid_query: Clause 7.0 asks for 24 x 7 operations while clause 6.8 asks for staff five days a week in office hours. Please state the required support hours and who must be available outside office hours.

unclear_points.why: Which trading platforms are meant is not named.
unclear_points.quote: The software developed should be compatible to integrate with trading platforms
unclear_points.prebid_query: Clause 6.1 says the software should be compatible to integrate with trading platforms. Please name the platforms and say whether the integration is in scope.

unclear_points.why: Blockchain is listed in the financial form with no description of what it must do.
unclear_points.prebid_query: Item 11 of the financial bid form lists block chain technology. Please describe the functions it must support and whether it is in scope.

unclear_points.why: Milestone 4 is missing and payment is said to be quarterly.
unclear_points.quote: Payment will be made on quarterly basis. Any payment to be released under the project will be
unclear_points.prebid_query: Clause 13.0 lists milestones 1 to 3 and 5 to 7 and says payment is quarterly. Please confirm the milestones, their percentages and how quarterly payment applies.

unclear_points.why: An EMD value is stated, but later clauses say EMD is not applicable.
unclear_points.prebid_query: The important dates sheet states an EMD value while clause 15.13 says EMD forfeiture and return are not applicable. Please confirm whether EMD is payable.

unclear_points.why: Regional languages are not named or counted.
unclear_points.quote: The Software should have provision for multi-lingual usage. Such as English, Hindi and Regional
unclear_points.prebid_query: Clause 6.1 asks for English, Hindi and regional languages. Please list the regional languages required.
